messages:
Zoe H.: Quick sync — we're finalizing launch posts for Benchmark 2. Need micro-meta + JSON-LD schema + redirect plan before publish. Can we triage?
Rahul S.: On it. Can you list priority pages? I can run extraction and draft schema.
Zoe H.: Priority pages: /benchmarks/latency, /benchmarks/cost, /blog/launch-notes, + landing page and /webinar/signup.
Marco G.: I'll own the internal linking map + canonicalization rules. Will push a sheet and link short IDs.
Olivia P.: I'll coordinate PR for snippet tests. Need meta descriptions for each, and JSON-LD examples. @seo-bot any quick schema recs? :mag:
seo-bot: Suggested JSON-LD types: Article + BreadcrumbList for blogs; WebPage + PotentialAction for signup/landing. See https://schema.org — recommend `mainEntityOfPage` and `datePublished` where available.
Rahul S.: Example snippet I'll use for blog pages:
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Article","headline":"{{title}}","author":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"},"datePublished":"{{date}}"}
```
Zoe H.: Perfect. Redirects: we have legacy /docs/benchmarks -> new /benchmarks, and a couple of old blog slugs. Can we plan a 301 sweep? @Marco G. can you add to redirect sheet and flag high-traffic paths?
Marco G.: Added initial rows. Also flagging anchor pruning — remove low-value anchors from homepage hero -> benchmark pages and replace with contextual CTAs.
Olivia P.: Action items (short):
- Rahul: generate JSON-LD for the 3 pages + landing
- Marco: internal link map + redirect CSV with traffic tags
- Zoe: approve meta descriptions
- content-ops: prep release notes + webhook for webinar reg
content-ops: Got it. For redirects, prefer 301s. CSV sample I'm adding to sheet:
url_from,url_to,code,note
/docs/benchmarks,/benchmarks,301,legacy docs
/blog/old-launch,/blog/launch-notes,301,old slug
Zoe H.: Can someone draft meta description for /benchmarks/cost? Keep 120-155 chars, emphasize cost/perf for engineers.
Rahul S.: Draft: "Compare inference costs and latency tradeoffs across models and deployment modes — practical guidance for engineers building LLM features."
Olivia P.: Nice. Shorten slightly to fit: "Compare inference costs and latency tradeoffs across models and deployment modes — practical guidance for engineers."
Marco G.: I'll wire those into the sheet. Also adding rel=canonical rule: canonicalize to /benchmarks/{slug} (no query params), ensure syndication pages have explicit canonical tags.
Zoe H.: :thumbsup: Timeline check — want schema + redirects live by next Wed before launch. Any blockers?
content-ops: ETA: schema draft by Tue EOD, redirects CSV Wed AM, deploy Wed PM. Tagging @eng-frontend for snippet validation and staging flag.
eng-frontend: We can toggle structured data via a feature flag on staging. Send final URLs and I'll run Search Console emulator + snippet screenshots.
Zoe H.: Thanks team. I'll follow up with a compact checklist in the doc and assign owners there. If anything blocks, drop updates in this thread.
